home.heroSubtitle: A 17th-century castle, 400 hectares of nature and the world's largest trotting training centre, 15 km from Paris-Vincennes.
home.entriesTitle: What would you like to do?
home.spacesIntro: Six exceptional venues for seminars, receptions, film shoots and weddings, for up to 1,500 guests.

agenda.title: Events & tickets
agenda.intro: Guided tours, special days and public events: book your tickets online.
agenda.groupsText: From 10 people, visits are booked on request with a personalised quote.
agenda.ticketsText: Online ticketing is provided by the estate's ticketing platform (to be confirmed). Payment is secure; tickets are sent by e-mail.
agenda.practical: The estate is private and accessible by reservation only.
agenda.pageLead: Guided tours, special days and public events. Dates and prices are examples.
agenda.pageDescription: Guided tours, special days and events at Domaine de Grosbois. Weezevent ticketing is not connected in this prototype.
agenda.groupsBanner: For a group, the visit is prepared with a quote. The figures in this prototype are indicative and are not sent.

space.layoutsIntro: Each figure is the number of guests the room can hold, depending on how the tables and seats are arranged.
space.dashNote: A dash means this layout is not specified for the room.
space.noRooms: Capacities for this venue depend on the event (marquee, garden party, installation). Describe your project in the quote request.

cookies.title: Cookies and privacy
cookies.text: This site uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation. With your consent, third-party services (maps, videos, ticketing, analytics) may set other cookies. You can change your choice at any time.
cookies.notice: Demo banner: the final version will use the tarteaucitron CMP (SETF contract).

newsletter.title: Get the estate's news
newsletter.text: Visits, events, behind the scenes of the training centre: one letter a month, no more.
newsletter.consent: I agree to receive the Domaine de Grosbois newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time via the link in each e-mail.
newsletter.privacy: Your data is processed by SETF to send the newsletter (legal basis: consent). Learn more: Privacy & cookies.
newsletter.demo: Prototype: no data is sent or stored.

quote.metaPrivatize: Quote form for a private hire or a visit at Domaine de Grosbois. On-screen simulation, nothing is sent.
quote.metaVisit: Booking or enquiry for a visit at Domaine de Grosbois. Indicative quote on screen, nothing is sent.
quote.introPrivatize: Describe a private hire or a visit. The summary appears here, with an indicative quote if you choose “booking”.
quote.introVisit: Individual visit, group, school or company. Choose “booking” for an indicative quote, or “enquiry” for a simple question.
quote.flexible: I am flexible on the date
quote.billingHint: If it differs from the contact address.
quote.consent: I agree that SETF may use this information to reply to my request. In this prototype, nothing is sent or stored: the summary stays in the browser.
quote.noSend: No PDF, no email, no payment. The amounts are a working assumption.
quote.noEmail: No email is sent. No PDF is generated. The information stays in your browser.
quote.noscript: Enable JavaScript to display the summary. No data is transmitted.
quote.aside1: It prepares a summary, with prices only for a booking.
quote.aside3: The Weezevent account is not used here: public ticketing is on the events page.
